question: When did the Riverside Public Library open, and how many items can members borrow?

demos.name: demo 1: fully supported
demos.response: The Riverside Public Library opened in 1998. Members can borrow up to 15 items at a time for three weeks.

demos.name: demo 2: changed number (15 -> 25 items)
demos.response: The Riverside Public Library opened in 1998. Members can borrow up to 25 items at a time for three weeks.

demos.name: demo 3: added unsupported fact
demos.response: The Riverside Public Library opened in 1998. Members can borrow up to 15 items at a time for three weeks. The library also has a rooftop café that serves free coffee to members.

demos.name: demo 4: supported paraphrase
demos.response: Library cards are free for residents, and members can borrow up to 15 items at a time.
